rationale.consistency: Uses cmdutil.FlagErrorf, httpmock, cobra idioms and api field conventions; but adds AuthConfig.ActiveTokenType yet every command bypasses it via ActiveToken+ParseTokenType, and gh.AuthConfig interface is untouched.
rationale.edge_cases: Good file validation (same-file, empty, '-', sizes, code fences, ref defs), but explicitly violates 'if one upload fails nothing is written': partial uploads still post the body; issue edit swallows the upload error when other edits exist.
rationale.scope: Wires all six commands and refusals as asked; includes dead code (isSingleImage, UploadStub) and invents partial-success semantics; long help text not documented, only the flag usage string.
rationale.readability: Well-commented but references.go is a dense 800-line hand-rolled inline scanner with 6-value returns and heavy index arithmetic; command wiring is clear.
rationale.robustness: Files and response bodies closed, no panics; however partial-failure paths write bodies and issue edit drops uploadErr silently on non-body edits, so users can lose an error entirely.
rationale.maintainability: Hand-rolled markdown inline parser beside goldmark is a large maintenance burden against the 'parse with goldmark' brief; config/token/uploader construction is copy-pasted across six commands.
